serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I actually did.
Shanice: W-what?! No way!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: How did you manage it?
You: I know a guy. His name is Big Daddy.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: That’s more of a nickname.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: What can you tell us about this man? Is he trustworthy?
You: Yeah, he was the first person that learned about me having my bot and so far he kept it a secret.
Shanice: If he already knows about you having a sexbot and you are not in jail, I guess he’s alright.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I hope you didn’t tell him about your sexbot’s uniqueness.
You: I didn’t.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s good. Keep it that way
You: Why? He knows a lot of stuff, maybe he could help us?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You can’t ever be too careful Anon, Who knows what his real intentions are.
You: …
How can he say that? Big Daddy helped me and many other people with his shop and is overall a nice guy…
Shanice: What did this Big Daddy character tell you anyway?
You: Right. He told me about some of the organizations. 
You: So far he told me about Connoisseurs. That’s how members of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism called themselves.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Butt.
You: Butt?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism, in short BUTT.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Wait, is that name for real?
You: Well, its abbreviation is a little unfortunate, that’s true.
Shanice: They are BUTT- Connoisseurs, haha! Can’t make this shit up!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Are you sure that Big Daddy didn’t deceive you?
You: I-I’m sure! {{wi}}I think. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Alright then. I will try to find some information in my database. Give me a minute…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: Wait. For real?
You: I told you Big Daddy was trustworthy.
Shanice: Alright, my bad. In my defense, their name sucks.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: What can you tell us about them?
You: I was told that they no longer exist. They were trying to create a utopia by automatization of everything. When their ambitions were deemed impossible to realize, they wanted to create a Proto-god who would create this Utopia for them. Ultimately, their views were banned internationally and most of them were caught.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: If all of the nations of the world were involved in their demise, no wonder I couldn’t find any information.
Shanice: So that’s it. They no longer exist so there’s no danger.
You: That’s only one of the organizations. 
Shanice: There’s more?
You: Big Daddy is a part of a Binary Birthright Coalition. They basically want to give human rights to bots.
Shanice: Well, that’s kinda wholesome.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: More like cheese.
Shanice: What, are you against it? Aren’t you a bot yourself.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Ecclesiasticalots are property of the Church.
Shanice: Speak for yourself. I’m sure many of you Priestcans would want to get a little more freedom.
Shanice: It doesn’t seem like this organization would want to steal your lady away, Anon. You must be glad.
You: Yeah.
